title: Command
description: The ⌘K palette: one input that searches actions and pages, driven from the keyboard.
usage: For apps with many actions or pages. Trigger it with a button and with Cmd/Ctrl+K; selecting an item is the app’s job.
a11y: Native modal dialog. Search keeps focus on a labelled combobox; Up/Down loop through listbox options, Enter activates a command, Escape closes and restores the opener. Empty results and a polite result count are provided. Composition events and IME keys are ignored during selection.
